*TOCLVL2*Summary of Benefits*TOCLVL2*

Office Visit (Primary Care): $25 copay in-network.
Specialist Visit: $40 copay in-network.
Outpatient Surgery: 20% coinsurance in-network.
Emergency Room: $250 copay.

*TOCLVL2*Mental Health and Substance Use Disorder Benefits*TOCLVL2*

Outpatient mental health office visit: $50 copay in-network.
Substance use disorder outpatient counseling: $50 copay in-network.
Inpatient mental health admission: 20% coinsurance in-network.
